name: nginx-multisite
description: Installs and configures nginx for three-site virtual hosting with static content, SSL, and security hardening including Fail2ban, firewall, sysctl, and SSH restrictions.

name: cache
description: Configures Memcached and Redis, including service enablement, Redis authentication, log directory management, and cleanup of selected Redis configuration settings.

name: fastapi-tutorial
description: Deploys a FastAPI tutorial application with system Python dependencies, a Git checkout, virtual environment, PostgreSQL database and user, environment configuration, and a systemd-managed Uvicorn service.
